items.title: 'I'm in Lamine Yamal's locker' NFL players startruck in Madrid
items.summary: Ted Karrass is a six-foot-four 310lb offensive lineman tasked with mauling the strongest athletes on the planet. Lamine Yamal is about five inches shorter and nearly half the weight, his forte: flair and finesse. It is quite the crossover of sporting specimens.
